messages:
rachel: kicked off v4.0 canary deploy to us-west about 7m ago. initial healthchecks passed but smoketests are showing embed p95 spike and a couple 504s.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.0 started -> canaries deployed (6/6). release tag: v4.0.0-rc1.

smokebot: synthetic-run: /v1/embed had 2x 504s and elevated p95 over baseline (1.8x). failing samples both from usw-can-02.

mike: seeing timeout traces in proxy: "upstream read timeout" on shard=7 for usw-can-02. metrics show a burst of kv cache misses at startup.

ana -> ana: typo -> ana: cc'ing infra, could this be kv prewarm backlog on startup? new nodes warm cache asynchronously.

rachel: running a focused probe against usw-can-02 now, posting command: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://usw-can-02.api.redwood/v1/embed -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"input":"probe-1"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

rachel: results x4: 200 0.17, 504 0.32, 504 0.30, 200 0.16 (intermittent).

mike: tailing host logs: ```WARN kv_prefill backlog=12 worker=2 prefix=embed_model_a```. looks like prefill queue drained slowly on that node.

ana: plan: trigger targeted prefill for embed prefixes on the host, retest. proposal: hold roll to rest of us-west for 30m after successful retest, and keep v4.0 pinned to canaries for 12h. add note to changelog about transient prewarm lag and ops playbook.

rachel: executing prefill command now and will paste output.

rachel: prefill output -> "queued 4 prefixes -> workers processed 4 -> completed in 22s".

smokebot: rerun synthetic -> /v1/embed 6/6 success from usw-can-02. p50/p95 back to baseline.

mike: recommend enabling temporary alert for embed p99 and kv_prefill_backlog > 5 for 12h. i'll create it.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of us-west in 30m from 6155332060.

rachel: decision: we continue with cautious rollforward plan but hold if the alert fires. keep canaries pinned for 12h. i will update internal release notes: "v4.0.0-rc1 - gradual deploy. Observed transient kv prefill lag on canary usw-can-02 causing intermittent 504s to /v1/embed; mitigation: targeted prefill executed and verification succeeded. Rollout resumed with 30m observation window and pin on canaries for 12h. Ops playbook added."

ana: add customer-facing blurb: short note about a minor canary-only blip resolved before general rollout. i'll help draft the blurb for #customers.

mike: filed follow-up ticket INFRA-6789 "improve prefill concurrency and startup visibility".

rachel: checklist for oncall during the 30m observation: 1) monitor embed p99 2) watch kv_prefill_backlog 3) if failure rate >3% over 5m, abort and rollback canaries.

ana: i'll watch the channel for the next hour and escalate if needed.

rachel: thanks everyone. neat catch by smokebot. :sparkles:

smokebot: reaction :eyes:.

mike: after-action: hold on public changelog until 12h observation passes, internal note only.

rachel: agreed. closing thread after observation window unless something happens.
